title: Titanium Pump Shaft Sleeve
alloyReason: Grade 2 CP-Ti (UNS R50400) is selected for Titanium Pump Shaft Sleeve where formability and corrosion resistance are prioritized over absolute strength. With 40% elongation and excellent weldability, Grade 2 CP-Ti forms a stable TiO₂ passive film that provides immunity to pitting in chloride environments up to 260°C. Its 345 MPa yield strength with 30% elongation makes it ideal for Pump shaft protective wear sleeve (Grade 5) requiring cold forming or bending without cracking. This rationale is driven by pump shaft protective wear sleeve (grade 5) and service environment demands.
process: CNC machining from plate for pump geometry
TIG welding all-position with Class 6g gauge
Passivation DI rinse with Class 6g gauge
surfaceTreatment: Pickling HF-HNO3 bath + passivation to restore passive film integrity on welded/seamed process surfaces — tailored for pump shaft protective application
commonFailures: Weld zone preferential attack in chlorinated water - controlled by post-weld pickling and proper filler selection — critical for pump shaft protective performance

faq.q: What pH range can Titanium Pump Shaft Sleeve withstand in effluent streams?
faq.a: Grade 2 CP-Ti maintains corrosion rates below 0.05 mm/year across pH 2-12 at 40°C in chloride-containing effluents. For pump shaft protective handling acidic or alkaline waste streams, titanium eliminates the need for polymer linings or acid-resistant brick, reducing maintenance costs by approximately 60% over the 10-year design life.

faq.a: Each Titanium Pump Shaft Sleeve shipment includes EN 10204 Type 3.1 mill test certificate with chemical analysis, mechanical properties, and heat identification. Dimensional inspection reports and Certificate of Conformance (CoC) are standard. First Article Inspection Reports (FAIR) per AS9102 are available on request for pump shaft protective.
